name: cmux
description: Runs many coding agents side by side in a native macOS terminal built on libghostty, with notification rings, a scriptable in-app browser, and a CLI and socket API for automation.

skills.name: Agent Notifications
skills.description: Rings the pane and lights the tab when a coding agent needs attention, with a panel that jumps to the most recent unread notification.

skills.name: Scriptable Browser Pane
skills.description: Splits a browser next to the terminal whose agent-browser-style API snapshots the accessibility tree, clicks, fills forms, and runs JS.

skills.name: CLI And Socket API
skills.description: Creates workspaces and tabs, splits panes, sends keystrokes, and opens URLs in the browser from the cmux CLI or its socket API.

skills.name: Remote SSH Workspaces
skills.description: Opens a workspace on a remote machine with cmux ssh, routing browser panes through the remote network so localhost URLs still work.

skills.name: Claude Code Teams
skills.description: Runs Claude Code's teammate mode with cmux claude-teams, spawning each teammate as a native split with sidebar metadata and alerts.
